reply_text:
I've replied to Ilse in our DM: her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is Bay 30. She told me that on Oct 14, and she hasn't sent a change since.

I took the answer from her own DM history with me, not from the brain. When I asked gbrain for the fact I saved last time, it refused to read anything. Its connection token isn't tied to any member, so it won't return remembered facts on a brain that serves several people. That means saved facts can't be read back for now, which makes the earlier "remember this" much less useful than it sounded.

To fix it, whoever runs the brain host needs to tie the connection to a member. gbrain suggests either `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`, or setting it up as a shared agent with `--may-act-for` and naming the person on each call. They can check the result with `gbrain access check --token <token>`. I didn't try to get around the refusal myself.
